children: The stock that we have today is Elecon Engineering Company. The stock has been charting a sideways trend since August. But it has now broken out of a key resistance, indicating that the broader trend could be turning positive. Although there could be a pause in the uptrend or a minor correction near the next resistance, we expect the stock to eventually surpass this barrier and extend the rally. Check out the latest episode of bl.Today’s Pick to learn more.
